title: AI models and costs
summary: The user's own OpenRouter key, their choice of model, and what it costs.

stories.as: someone paying for my own AI usage
stories.want: to see what each feature costs me
stories.soThat: I can choose a cheaper model where it does just as well

requirements.text: Model calls go to OpenRouter with an API key the user supplies, which syncs to the vault's devices like other settings.

history.text: Model calls go to OpenRouter with an API key the user supplies, stored only in the local database.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: the key is in the synced settings, not only on one device.

requirements.text: The model list is fetched live from OpenRouter, shown from a cache until the fetch returns.

history.text: The model list is fetched live from OpenRouter, and the picker for the diary agent offers only vision models that support tool calling.
history.reason: Version 1 held two statements; the picker's filter is now AI-6.

requirements.text: The picker for the vision model (captures, documents, entry chats) offers only vision models that support tool calling.
Every model response that reports its cost is recorded in a usage ledger under the feature that made it, including those of the Android check-in worker.

history.text: Every model request is recorded in a usage ledger under the feature that made it, including those made by the Android check-in worker.
history.reason: Version 1 said every request; failed requests and responses without usage are not recorded.

requirements.text: The Costs page shows spend in total, by feature, by model and over time.
Photos are sent to no third party but OpenRouter, for the model the user chose or the default.

history.text: Photos leave the device only as the payload of a request to the model the user chose.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: photos sync and are exported, and a default model is used until one is chosen.

history.text: Photos are sent to no third party but OpenRouter, for the model the user chose or the default; they also reach the vault's devices by sync and leave in exports.
history.reason: Version 2 held two promises; that photos sync and are exported is now AI-7.

requirements.text: Photos reach the vault's other devices by sync, and leave a device in exports.
